redFirst.basis: `npx vitest run tools/ui-tests/confirm-write.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 on "Cannot find module '../ui-checks/confirm-write.mjs' imported from <outside-repo>" (read as node), and the missing module is tools/ui-checks/confirm-write.mjs, which the task declares: tools/ui-checks/confirm-write.mjs is absent from HEAD and present in the working tree; a second run with the working tree's implementation copied in exited 0 without that error, its tests reaching their assertions; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop; deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: New tools/ui-checks/confirm-write.mjs holds confirmWrite (moved out of tools/capture-screenshots.mjs with its body and failure sentences unchanged; the only signature change is a fourth parameter `during`, the run's progress marker it used to close over), the three write descriptors COMPOSITION_WRITE/CONFIG_WRITE/PROPOSAL_WRITE, CONFIRM_ANSWER_MS, and CONFIRM_WAIT_ALLOWED (file/find/sites/reason rows, all Discards: comp, discardBtn, guards, ado x2 in the tool; policy in stage-tabs). capture-screenshots.mjs imports them, passes `during` at its nine call sites, adds `during` to stageCtx, and drops the POLL_WAIT_ALLOWED row `timeout: CONFIRM_ANSWER_MS`, whose wait left the file (gate-card-wait.test.mjs would otherwise report it stale). stage-tabs.mjs imports confirmWrite, CONFIG_WRITE (the policy save PUTs /api/config, policy-view.js) and CONFIRM_ANSWER_MS; both policy saves (old lines 978 and 1016, each click + waitForTimeout(900)) go through confirmWrite. The successful save toasts BEFORE it re-reads /api/policy and repaints, so it is followed by a waitForFunction on POLICY.stored.skills.deny naming the subject (or a findings.err box), bounded by CONFIRM_ANSWER_MS; on timeout the existing fail sentences get a clause saying the page never took the re-read. The refused save paints findings then toasts, so the helper alone is enough there. New tools/ui-tests/confirm-write.test.mjs: derives the gate's files from capture-screenshots.mjs's relative imports (transitively), tokenises each (comments, strings, regex literals), splits statements at bracket depth zero, and reports a data-cfgo click whose next awaited statement is waitForTimeout/setTimeout/sleepPollWindow as `file:line (fixed wait at line N)`, except inside confirmWrite's body in the helper module and except sites a CONFIRM_WAIT_ALLOWED row's find matches (matched against the code from the dialog's opener through the wait). Cases cw1-cw5. Mutation probes in throwaway copies of the test (deleted afterwards): isFixedWait->false reddens cw1-cw4; stale filter->[] reddens cw3; helper-body skip removed reddens cw4; isConfirmClick->any click (over-fire) reddens cw1, cw2; a non-await statement ending the scan reddens cw2, cw4. Runs: `npx vitest run` exit 0, 58 files / 858 tests, twice (before and after a header reflow); `node --check` on all three .mjs exit 0; tests/test__panel_page.py --selftest 490/490 exit 0; tests/test__refs.py --selftest 292/292 exit 0. The browser gate was not run, per the brief. Dependants: tools/ui-tests/gate-card-wait.test.mjs - still correct, green in the full vitest run: it reads POLL_WAIT_ALLOWED and the waits of capture-screenshots.mjs only, and the one row whose wait moved out was removed; it no longer polices the helper's waitForFunction, which now lives in confirm-write.mjs and is policed instead by confirm-write.test.mjs's structure (not by poll-dependence). Repro mode - shares the legs through the same functions and stageCtx, so it gets the converted sites; not run (it is the browser gate). tests/test__panel_page.py - still correct, 490/490: it names stage-tabs.mjs only in a comment. tools/check-report-interactive.mjs, armed-reason/capture-provenance/gate-reasons tests - import exports of capture-screenshots.mjs that are unchanged; green in vitest. plugins/audit/scripts/ui/panel/overview.js and tools/ui-tests/overview-outcome.test.mjs - name stage-tabs.mjs in comments only. docs/screenshots/captured-at.json, _evidence_io.py, panel-server.py, tests/test__refs.py, tools/check-committed-pii.py - name the tool by path/prose; nothing they read changed. Owed entries: none found - tools/affected.py routes tools/ui-checks/ by prefix (line 956), wiring.mjs reads the directory and only tracks assert* functions (the new module declares none), and the vitest include glob already covers tools/ui-tests/. Not done, out of scope: blank() in gate-card-wait.test.mjs and strip() here are two tokenisers of the same JS source; extracting one shared scanner module under tools/ui-tests/ would need a file outside this task's files.
outcome.descriptive: Every file the panel gate runs now confirms a write through one helper in tools/ui-checks/confirm-write.mjs, the policy saves no longer read after a fixed 900 ms, and a unit test fails a confirm-then-sleep by file and line.

testsAdded: cw1: the gate's own files, derived from the tool's imports, carry no unexcused confirm-then-fixed-wait, and every allow row excuses exactly its stated count with a reason (rows proven load-bearing)
cw2: a click-then-sleep put back into a copy of the tool or of stage-tabs, in three click shapes and three wait shapes, is reported with the file and the click's line
cw3: an allow row matching nothing (or naming a file outside the gate) is stale, a row matching more than it says is broad, a row with a blank reason is unreasoned

cw4: a confirm followed by an answer-waiting read, a confirmWrite call followed by a wait, a wait inside a following block, and the helper's own click are not reported; a non-await statement between click and wait does not hide the wait; an unclosed string makes the tokeniser throw
cw5: confirmWrite is declared once, in ui-checks/confirm-write.mjs, and both the tool and stage-tabs import it from there and call it at two or more sites
